scope: all MTP forward/head passes and prefill lookahead; measured primitives plus explicit analytical SWA/hc_head gaps

attention_provenance.module_scope: projection + compressor/indexer + sparse attention + output projection
attention_provenance.kv_cache_source_layout: fp8 source table; serving reference plain FP8
attention_provenance.extrapolation: measured boundary with parameterized DSV4 FLOP/byte SOL growth, max 64x

extrapolation_sol.model: DSV4 FLOP/byte roofline anchored to measured boundary efficiency
extrapolation_sol.basis: AIC dsv4_attention_sol_ms; local grouped FP8 output and BF16 compressors from vLLM
extrapolation_sol.cache_layout_evidence: source-table layouts inferred from collector defaults and current vLLM; historical version unverified
extrapolation_sol.efficiency: measured(boundary) / SOL(boundary); no fitted throughput multiplier

attention_provenance.extrapolation_axis_binding: each inner-axis growth uses its measured outer-axis node
attention_provenance.decode_batch_composition: query-row-weighted uniform full-batch module estimates; common projections counted once
attention_provenance.decode_query_width: expanded query compute and sparse-attention reads; indexer KV reuse within Q-blocks

mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.basis: pinned DeepGEMM SM100 paged MQA groups request Q-blocks; BLOCK_Q = 128 / indexer heads
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.query_math: unchanged at the full expanded query-row count
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.indexer_kv_read_fraction: sum(requests * ceil(query width / BLOCK_Q)) / query rows, per context; source geometry including clamps
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.cross_q_block_l2_reuse: not credited without measured traffic; tile reads are a conservative streaming estimate
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.sparse_attention_kv_reads: per query retained; FlashInfer sparse indices may differ across queries
mtp_indexer_kv_reuse.latency: measured full-query-row module times adjusted/source SOL; math bound retained

attention_provenance.generation_ragged_grid: on out-of-range neighbors, use same-geometry batch slices within the existing 64x context/batch bound

draft_provenance.passes: full target token batch, then K-1 single-query batches
draft_provenance.input_projection: e_proj local rows; h_proj hc_mult * local rows
draft_provenance.attention: SWA only; measured low-rank GEMMs + analytical plain-FP8 single-latent core
draft_provenance.moe: one native routed/shared layer per pass
draft_provenance.head: one row/request (capture padding where FULL); analytic hc_head + norm + BF16 shared lm_head
draft_provenance.analytical_gaps_grade: D: SWA core, embedding/input-add and hc_head; no paired full draft module table
